findings.root_cause: Renderer validates old collision proof independently of the newer plan sample.
findings.required_correction: Bind collision capture interval and current action to the same fresh plan; reject old proof before rendering.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Age boundary, changed boot/generation, changed namespace after capture.

findings.root_cause: Unexpected resources failure can satisfy no-invocation cancellation.
findings.required_correction: Require scenario-specific coherent successful cancellation states and retain unexpected failures.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: No-invocation service failure, timer failure, contradictory result and final status.

findings.root_cause: Case-only external seal excludes top-level privilege-review references.
findings.required_correction: Seal complete result envelope and independently verify referenced review artifacts bound to the session.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Identity/environment/clock-basis substitution, failure-ledger deletion, rehash against fixed external seal.

findings.root_cause: Collision proof ignores explicit timeout and does not require complete command receipts.
findings.required_correction: Require all collision capture receipts and reject timeouts, overflow and incomplete output.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Partial stdout, nonzero ambiguity, missing UnitPath paths, wrong pair.

findings.root_cause: Create receipt can occur after the deadline and after waiting observations.
findings.required_correction: Enforce authorization issuance, creation, arm acknowledgment and waiting chronology.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Setup exactly at deadline, expired setup, missing arm acknowledgment, case runtime budget.

findings.root_cause: Duplicate receipt after firing can reuse earlier waiting snapshots.
findings.required_correction: Bracket duplicate submission/refusal with fresh same-generation observations before firing.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Timeout/refusal ambiguity, changed property, duplicate at firing boundary.

findings.root_cause: ExecStart exit trailer shape is accepted without comparison to main-process exit.
findings.required_correction: Parse exit observations and cross-check ExecStart, ExecMainCode/Status and journal.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Exit0/7/203/signals, missing status, wrong invocation and completion order.

findings.root_cause: Only an earlier failedtimer snapshot proves no invocation; later invocation passes.
findings.required_correction: Require no execution for the entire scenario through final closure, including final service identity.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Invocation after dependency failure, missing/late callback, nonzero final code.

findings.root_cause: Journal monotonic timestamp is parsed but discarded instead of correlated.
findings.required_correction: Normalize journal clock domain and compare against boot/UTC window and payload clocks.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Zero/out-of-window timestamps, offset limits, missing clock basis and drift.

findings.root_cause: Late acceptance has no upper window/capture bound; session+2800s callback passes.
findings.required_correction: Bind execution/completion and finalization to the original approved window; post-expiry always fails.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Exact expiry, delayed journal delivery versus execution time, intentionally late but in-window observation.

findings.root_cause: R21 rejects / because splitting produces an empty final path component.
findings.required_correction: Support explicit root descriptor metadata validation without bypassing ownership/nonwritable/no-follow checks.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Root, valid ancestors, symlink/writable/wrong-owner ancestors, malformed paths, stable identity.

findings.root_cause: Cgroup summary fields pass without raw population/process receipts.
findings.required_correction: Require raw bounded cgroup/process capture, exit/timeout and generation/boot/time correlation.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Missing file versus proven absence, populated group, stale receipt and partial cleanup.

findings.root_cause: A pre-cancellation journal receipt can claim coverage through closure.
findings.required_correction: Require actual capture/cursor coverage through the claimed endpoint and correlate receipt end time.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Capture before/at/after deadline, incomplete cursor range, late event after old empty capture.

findings.root_cause: Failed state can coexist with successful outcome fields without rejection.
findings.required_correction: Validate a case-specific coherent load/active/sub/result/exit/invocation matrix.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Failed/active/transitional contradictions and expected exit7 versus unexpected failure.

findings.root_cause: Fresh outer sample is not bound to show receipt times; 879-second-old receipts pass.
findings.required_correction: Bind each raw capture start/end and receipt to the observation bracket and exact generation.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Boundary ages, reversed brackets, missing capture times, previous-generation snapshots.

findings.root_cause: Claimed cancel time is not derived from actual stop receipts; D+10s stops pass.
findings.required_correction: Record request, acknowledgment, effective inactivity and observations separately; enforce causal order before D-5s.
findings.adjacent_regressions_required: Callback before/during/after cancellation, delayed acknowledgment, interrupted cleanup.
